desc: Something powering up. Rising, and it is going to end in something.
prompt: a science fiction energy weapon charging up, rising synthesised whine building in pitch and intensity, designed sound effect
negative: music, melody, speech, explosion, discharge, crowd, reverb
note: It must RISE and stop - pair with a discharge or it reads as an unresolved mistake.

evidence.method: audio_sweep: rendered + measured (ffmpeg ebur128/silencedetect, librosa flatness)
evidence.note: renders and is not broken [seconds=3.99, lufs=-9.1, true_peak=0.7, silent_fraction=0.23, channels=2]
